name: Kokoro 0.9.4 Neural Speech Synthesis Engine
purpose: Local deep learning speech synthesis integration using PyTorch, misaki, and espeak-ng producing 24 kHz mono PCM audio.
capabilities: High-speed local neural TTS inference on Apple Silicon
Zero cloud API latency and zero per-character cost

installation.instructions: Installed in local environment with weights cached locally.

compatibility.notes: Executes on Apple Silicon M-series using PyTorch MPS/CPU.

security.notes: Local neural model execution; no audio data leaves the local machine.

approval_evidence: Production certified in Stage 3 speech synthesis.
